g.title: scaler_bilinear
g.text: weights computed in hardware from the sub-pixel phase (PHASE_BITS = 8), no coefficient tables
1 output pixel per clock - 6 pipeline stages (A B W M1 S1 M2) + output register
pixel = CHANNELS x COMP_W bits (default 3 x 8), component 0 in the LSBs

g.title: regbus
g.text: AW and W in any order, OKAY responses

g.title: ctrl
g.text: capture FSM: SOF / EOL checks, writes the

g.title: dda
g.text: exact accumulation, SOF / EOL / EOF flags
stalls with the pipeline (adv), hold for LINE_BUF

g.title: fb
g.text: 2 x 2 RAM banks (B = 2): a 2x2 window every clock

g.title: dp
g.text: 6 stages (A B W M1 S1 M2) + output register
window register: p00 p01 / p10 p11
phases fx, fy travel with the data
